legs: Single continuous camera move, no cuts. The camera glides fast through the still crowd on the night sidewalk, heads bowed over glowing phones, the city streaking past in long light trails; then lightning flashes and the city lights go out block by block, only the phone screens still glowing on the bowed faces. Anonymous faces. No text, no brands.

Single continuous camera move, no cuts. In the dark rain the phone screens fade out one by one until there is only darkness and rain; then one thin glowing gold line draws itself in the dark, tracing the outline of hills, a shoreline and small homes on a far hillside. No text.

Single continuous camera move, no cuts. Dawn slowly comes up: the gold line drawing of the hills and homes fills with light and color and becomes the real place, Lake Chapala at dawn in soft mist, green hills and the small white homes on the far hillside, the rain gone. No text.
